script.title: DRIVER'S LICENSE RENEWAL
script.story_hook: One expired card, two quick tests, zero drama.
script.intro_zh: 一張到期的照卡，兩項小測試，一切順利。
script.welcome_en: Good morning, friends! Today we're renewing a driver's license.
script.welcome_zh: 各位早安！今天我們要到監理站換駕駛執照。
script.outro: License renewed, easy as pie! Practice again tomorrow, okay?
script.outro_zh: 駕照換好啦，一點也不難！明天再來一起練習，好嗎？
script.practice_intro_en: One more time — repeat each line with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 再來一次——跟著我把每句唸好。
script.char_a_description: a sprightly woman in her early sixties with short permed platinum hair, wearing a lavender windbreaker and glasses on a beaded chain, clutching a folder of documents
script.char_b_description: a patient man in his late thirties with warm brown skin, a long ginger beard, wearing a green plaid button-down and a badge lanyard, stamping forms between sentences

script.youtube_title_en: "My Bad Hair Day" — Renewing a Driver's License at the DMV
script.youtube_description:
到監理站換駕照，聽不懂流程該怎麼辦？取號、掏文件、視力測驗、現場拍照、拿紙本臨時照——跟著 Gloria 一次全聽明白！整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢出門辦照。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Renewing a driver's license in English can feel like a maze of counters and forms. Follow Gloria at the DMV as she takes a ticket, shows her documents, reads the vision chart, fixes her hair for the photo, and drives off on a paper license — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA. Repeat every line in the second half and go prepared.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new listening episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🚗換駕駛照英文｜取號等候・視力測驗・現場拍照｜聽完就會辦照｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
第一次自己到監理站換駕照，聽得懂嗎？
文件、視力測驗、拍照，每一關要說什麼？

這一集帶大家走進忙碌的監理站，跟著 Gloria 從取號等候、掏出文件、通過視力小測驗，到為「糟糕頭髮日」整理瀏海，最後拿到兩週有效的紙本臨時照，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🎫 報號與文件：例如「Do you have a ticket number with you?」。
👁️ 視力測驗：例如「Only a quick one, read those letters, please.」。
📸 拍照小插曲：例如「Aw, my bad hair day… can I fix my hair?」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先完整聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次要跑監理站，帶著這十八句安心出門！
script.thumbnail_action: holding up a folder of license documents

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to renew my driver's license.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪd laɪk tə rɪˈnu maɪ ˈdraɪvərz ˈlaɪsəns/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想續換我的駕駛執照。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, do you have a ticket number with you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt du ju hæv ə ˈtɪkɪt ˈnʌmbər wɪð ju/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, A forty-two. Is the wait long?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs eɪ ˈfɔrti tu ɪz ðə weɪt lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 有的，A四十二號。要等很久嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About twenty minutes, grab a seat over there.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnəts ɡræb ə sit ˈoʊvər ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 大約二十分鐘，那邊坐一下就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks. So, what papers do I need?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks soʊ wʌt ˈpeɪpərz du aɪ nid/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。那我需要帶什麼文件？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your current card and proof of address.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈkɜrənt kɑrd ənd pruf ɑv əˈdrɛs/
dialogue.zh: 現在的照卡，還有住址證明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here they are. My license expires next month.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ði ɑr maɪ ˈlaɪsəns ɪkˈspaɪrz nɛkst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 都帶來了。我的照卡下個月到期。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good timing! Do you live at the same address?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈtaɪmɪŋ du ju lɪv ət ðə seɪm əˈdrɛs/
dialogue.zh: 時間剛好在！你目前住的地方沒變吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same place, yes. Do I need a vision test too?
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm pleɪs jɛs du aɪ nid ə ˈvɪʒən tɛst tu/
dialogue.zh: 一樣住在這裡。也要做視力檢測嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only a quick one, read those letters, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ə kwɪk wʌn rid ðoʊz ˈlɛtərz pliːz/
dialogue.zh: 很快而已，請唸出那排的字母。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay… that line says twenty twenty, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊkeɪ ðæt laɪn sɛz ˈtwɛnti ˈtwɛnti raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好……那一行是二十二十，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You passed! One photo next, no smiling, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju pæst wʌn ˈfoʊtoʊ nɛkst noʊ ˈsmaɪlɪŋ ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你通過啦！接著拍一張照，不能笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Aw, my bad hair day… can I fix my hair?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔ maɪ bæd hɛr deɪ kæn aɪ fɪks maɪ hɛr/
dialogue.zh: 唉，頭髮超亂的日子……我能整理一下再拍嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, take your time — there, the bangs too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr teɪk jɔr taɪm ðɛr ðə bæŋz tu/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，慢慢來——瀏海也撥一撥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done! So when will the real card arrive?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn soʊ wɛn wɪl ðə riːl kɑrd əˈraɪv/
dialogue.zh: 好了！那正式照卡什麼時候會寄到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two weeks, meanwhile, here's a paper one.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wiːks ˈminwaɪl hɪrz ə ˈpeɪpər wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 兩個星期，先給你一張紙本的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I drive with this? It's just a printout.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ draɪv wɪð ðɪts dʒʌst ə ˈprɪntaʊt/
dialogue.zh: 拿這張紙就能開車嗎？這只是列印的耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, that's all — drive safe, and bye now!
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ðæts ɔl draɪv seɪf ənd baɪ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，全都辦完啦——行車小心，再見！
